name: data
_doc: The Data pack (owner request R-0239): 3 data-* SPECIALIST agents plus the existing data-scientist and ml-engineer specialists, which join by reference (no rename). For scraping public or permitted sources, data work and predictions. Evidence: AutoWeb (compliance-critic role). forge-router sends a scraping, data or prediction request to this pack; forge-pack.cjs (doctor check packs) is red when a pack agent or skill is missing, unrouted or not a registered specialist. Presets are expanded by forge-lane-skills.cjs (--require data-all,process). No login, paywall or bot-protection bypass; outreach stays a draft; never an automatic real-money action.
